2607.09424.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
2607.09424.paper_summary: We present Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign, open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model for German and English. Its hybrid design activates only 3B of 30B parameters per token and keeps the inference cache near-constant as context grows, giving it a decisive throughput advantage over dense models for long-context, high-concurrency deployment. Pretrained on roughly 27 trillion tokens with deliberately up-weighted German, Soofi S matches dense 14 to 27B models on aggregate English and German benchmarks while achieving the best code aggregates in both languages among 17 open base models, and outperforms every European sovereign baseline in our comparison, including ones far larger in active parameters. Among fully open models, Soofi S obtains the highest English and German evaluation scores, ahead of Olmo 3 32B and Apertus 70B. Soofi S was built end-to-end on the German Industrial AI Cloud, a sovereign HPC scale AI infrastructure operated by Deutsche Telekom in Munich. Soofi S will be released under highly permissive, open-access terms: weights, selected intermediate checkpoints, full per-source data accounting, hyperparameters, and training and evaluation code. Where source licenses permit, data-construction artifacts are released under permissive licenses; commercially licensed sources are documented with aggregate statistics and exact mixture accounting.
2607.09424.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Soofi S 30B-A3B，一個主權、開源的混合專家（MoE）混合 Mamba Transformer 基礎模型，適用於德語和英語。它的混合設計每個標記僅激活 30B 參數中的 3B，並在上下文增長時保持推理緩存幾乎不變，這使其在長上下文、高併發部署中相較於密集模型具有決定性的吞吐量優勢。Soofi S 在大約 27 萬億標記上進行預訓練，並有意提高德語的權重，與 14 到 27B 的密集模型在英語和德語的總體基準上相匹配，同時在 17 個開放基礎模型中實現了兩種語言中最佳的代碼總體表現，並在我們的比較中超越了每個歐洲主權基準，包括那些活躍參數遠大於它的模型。在完全開放的模型中，Soofi S 獲得了最高的英語和德語評估分數，超越了 Olmo 3 32B 和 Apertus 70B。Soofi S 是在德國工業 AI 雲端上端到端構建的，這是一個由德國電信在慕尼黑運營的主權 HPC 規模 AI 基礎設施。Soofi S 將在高度寬鬆的開放訪問條款下發布：權重、選定的中間檢查點、每個來源的數據核算、超參數以及訓練和評估代碼。在來源許可證允許的情況下，數據構建工件將在寬鬆的許可證下發布；商業授權的來源將以總體統計和精確的混合核算進行記錄。
